traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Fungus that forms large, bracket-like or hoof-shaped fruiting bodies on trees. The top surface is typically glossy and zonate with bands of different colors, ranging from white to red-brown to almost black. The underside contains many small pores where the spores are released. It's often found on dead or dying trees, where it can act as a decomposer (saprotrophic) or weak parasite. Although it's not poisonous, it's considered inedible due to its tough, woody texture.
